# ResponseHVAC

> Know which homes to work first.

## Product

ResponseHVAC is software for HVAC contractors. It helps HVAC contractors identify residential properties that may be worth contacting for HVAC replacement opportunities.

The current launch and validated market is Dallas, Texas. Dallas is the initial launch market and is not necessarily a permanent geographic limitation.

## What customers can do

- Configure a service area.
- View property opportunities.
- View evidence explaining why a property may be worth contacting.
- Filter opportunities.
- Inspect property details.
- Manage opportunity and lead status.
- Export filtered opportunities to CSV.

ResponseHVAC provides prospecting information and prioritization support. Property and HVAC evidence can be incomplete or outdated and does not establish that a property requires HVAC replacement.

Live Direct Mail fulfillment is not currently enabled.

## Commercial terms

- Price: $99/month.
- Trial: 5-day free trial.
